summary: Tested the new VIP Availability Calendar 1h/2h/3h slot booking end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (test_vip_schedule_slots.py). GET /api/vip/schedule/{lena}/slots returns durations=[60,120,180], buffer=15, day windows [{from:18:00,to:23:00}] for 2026-10-15, and the pending 19:00-20:00 booking appears in 'taken' with lock_from=18:45 lock_to=20:15. POST /book correctly rejects 20:00-21:00 (409 SLOT_TAKEN, respects 15-min buffer around existing booking), 17:30-18:30 (400 TIME_UNAVAILABLE), 18:00-18:30 (400 BAD_DURATION), 20:15-21:45 (400 BAD_DURATION), and accepts 20:15-22:15 (200). /reschedule enforces the same BAD_DURATION / TIME_UNAVAILABLE rules while excluding the current booking from conflict check. Normal-date cross-check: inserting an accepted date_bookings for Lena at 21:00 local causes slots endpoint to surface it under taken as status='date' with lock_from=20:45 lock_to=23:45 and VIP booking 20:45-22:45 is rejected with 409 SLOT_TAKEN. Frontend: /profile/{lena} as admin shows profile-open-schedule → opens vs-book-dialog with vs-book-day-2026-10-15, vs-book-dur-1h/2h/3h, TimeChooser (vs-book-time + vs-book-time-summary). Switching duration updates summary (Date starts 20:15 → ends 21:15 for 1h, 22:15 for 2h; 3h has no valid starts because 20:15+3h would exceed 23:00 window so TimeChooser renders vs-book-time-no-slots — correct). Start options correctly exclude the 18:45-20:15 locked range (first available 20:15, hour quick picks 21:00 & 22:00 for 1h). vs-book-submit creates a pending booking (toast: 'Request sent — waiting for VIP confirmation'); created booking cleaned up after test (coins refunded). Normal date invite modal (profile-view-date-button) still opens with the day-picker + TimeChooser (2.5h default) — regression intact.

issues: Quick-picks label is hardcoded to 'Quick picks (2.5h)' via the quick_slots i18n key even when the selected duration is 1h/2h/3h. Low priority copy nit — the picks themselves are correctly re-filtered per duration.

action_items: (nit) Replace the hardcoded '(2.5h)' in i18n key quick_slots with a dynamic duration label inside TimeChooser.jsx so VipScheduleBookModal shows '(1h)/(2h)/(3h)' instead of '(2.5h)'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _vs_extra_checks (3755-3760): duration gate uses tuple VIP_DURATIONS=(60,120,180) and correctly rejects 90/30/other; normal-date lock buffer applied via _vs_normal_locks + 15-min lock_from/lock_to from _block — matches spec.

server.py vs_public_slots (3851-3881): adds durations, per-day windows, and taken (incl. 'date' entries from _vs_normal_locks with lock_from/lock_to) — frontend TimeChooser consumes these correctly via freeStarts(wins, taken, minStart, slot).

server.py vs_book / vs_reschedule: both call _vs_extra_checks AFTER the window/overlap guards; reschedule excludes itself ({'id':{'$ne':bid}}) so a user can shrink/expand their own booking without self-conflict — correct.

VipScheduleBookModal.jsx line 48: on open resets dur=60; passing key={`${day}-${dur}`} to TimeChooser forces re-mount on duration change so startMin is re-picked from valid starts for that duration — good UX pattern.

availability.js freeStarts(slot) and freeRanges(slot) now accept slot param — correctly flows from VipScheduleBookModal's dur state through TimeChooser (slot={dur}). Verified: 2h duration excludes 20:00 start (would overlap lock 20:00-20:15 end-buffer) and 3h duration yields no valid starts.
TimeChooser.jsx line 39: quick_slots i18n label contains hardcoded '(2.5h)' — see design_issues above.
